fusions.name: Wrench Loose
fusions.desc: Wrenches the target's guard open, dealing 9 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Uprooted Lob
fusions.desc: Gaffs a chunk out of the ground and hurls it overhand. It deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that, with a 50% chance per hit to leave them [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bough Swing
fusions.desc: Catches a hold ahead and swings you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
